_about: Inputs for tools/cfp_sim.py. ranking = the latest CFP committee top 25 in order. ccg = conference title games already set (team names as in the cfbfastR schedule). bracket = the 12 seeds in order once the committee releases the final bracket (leave [] until then). Update this file when a new CFP ranking comes out, title-game spots are clinched, or the bracket is set.
